candidate_evidence.quote: Participants will engage in two to three virtual physical activity sessions a week through the BurnAlong app for three months with a chosen partner

coder_notes: Behavioural virtual physical-activity intervention for AYA cancer survivors after completion of treatment; glioblastoma listed among conditions of a multi-cancer population. No drug or biologic intervention. Phase NA. Treatment setting is survivorship (post-treatment), coded unclear.
